prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Digitech-Areal", an abandoned and overgrown corporate campus at the edge of the rich upper city: cracked pale concrete plaza and broken white floor tiles with weeds, moss and small bushes growing through the cracks; this cracked plaza is the large walkable area in the middle and lower half of the image, flat and open.
TOP, the whole upper row: the ruined lower floors of a once shiny office tower, white concrete and chrome, many glass panes smashed; in the upper middle a big section of the glass facade has collapsed outward and lies in front of it as a heap of glass shards and bent window frames.
TOP CENTER-LEFT on the tower facade: the most eye-catching spot - an open doorway with a metal staircase leading down into darkness (cellar stairs), a cold blue lamp above it.
TOP LEFT: a lower side wing with an open archive door, rows of filing cabinets visible inside.
TOP CENTER-RIGHT against the facade: an emergency power terminal, a boxy console with a screen flickering bright green and glowing cables.
TOP RIGHT corner: a delivery zone gate with a red-and-white barrier boom, a security camera on a pole and a small booth, a road leading out of the image.
RIGHT SIDE: an enormous dormant security robot, a bulky rusted bipedal colossus kneeling motionless with its head bowed, vines growing over it; smaller rusted guard robots lie toppled on the plaza nearby.
BOTTOM LEFT: a small gatehouse booth with a window, a lamp and a wooden bench next to it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a scavengers' camp - a tarp tent, a burning oil barrel, sleeping bags, piles of salvaged cables and screens.
BOTTOM CENTER: a square cable-shaft hatch in the ground, filled with rubble and broken bricks.
Small things at the edges: overgrown planters, broken benches, toppled corporate logo sculpture (abstract shape, no letters), puddles.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: LEFT edge (west) - the inside of a construction fence with poster boards seen from the back and a gap in the fence; TOP edge (north) right - the delivery zone barrier road.
Light and material: Oberstadt edge - cold white and chrome, dusty grey, green flicker of the terminal, a few violet neon reflections from the distant city; evening, after rain.
